**Sometime in the morning** So it seems to me, that I have an addictive personality; however, before all of this, I did not have the level of control that I have now. I never had this level of focus to truly control one thing at a time to be addicted to.

Music is my substance of choice, but now I have started smoking (roughly 2 months ago), and I want to quit. Addiction scares me for the obvious reasons, but mostly because of the lack of control. Or, rather, something being in control of me. I do not want a chemical substance to determine my day. Music seems a lot safer of a substance in be intoxicated by.

**Right now** I can feel the last remnants of mania (maybe I have downgraded to hypomania, cannot tell) slipping through my fingers. I feel a lot less confident about my ability to make changes in my life. It may just be a temporary feeling in this moment. I do not feel the feeling of impending doom, not yet. Maybe I am just bored. Anxiety is fading thanks, in part, to my medication.

I do not believe, for me, that any drug can touch the high of mania. I will say that I have not experimented with drugs, so I do not have any firsthand knowledge of addiction. To be so very certain of myself is intoxicating. To know things about myself, and see endless possibilities is a feeling that I cannot describe in my current state of mind. I am okay, but I miss my mania when it goes. Unfortunately, she leaves a mess in her wake.

Edit to clarify that I do not personally know what it is like to be addicted to a chemical substance (except cigarettes, for right now). But I do find other things to be addicted to, with work being the main one. Random hobbies come in second when I actually take off enough time to focus on something else other than working.
